headline: Cocktail explosion outside NCP office in Dhaka's Bangla Motor; two unexploded devices defused
summary: Unidentified motorcyclists threw three cocktails at the National Citizens Party (NCP) central office. One exploded, while police later defused the remaining two.
details: A cocktail explosion occurred on the road adjacent to the central office of the National Citizens Party (NCP) in Dhaka's Bangla Motor area. The incident took place late Thursday night, around 12:30 AM.
Motorcycle-riding miscreants reportedly threw three cocktails at the NCP office. One of these devices exploded, while the other two remained unexploded at the scene.
Police officials quickly arrived at the location following the incident. They successfully defused the two unexploded cocktail devices, ensuring public safety.
caption:

headline_marked: [[Dhaka markets and museums to remain closed]] on Friday, plan your trips accordingly
headline: Dhaka markets and museums to remain closed on Friday, plan your trips accordingly
summary: A list of markets and museums in Dhaka will observe their weekly holiday on Friday, October 16. Residents are advised to check the list before heading out to avoid inconvenience.
details: Many markets and shopping centers in Dhaka observe weekly closures on Fridays. Knowing which ones are closed can help city dwellers avoid unnecessary trips and frustration.
For Friday, October 16, several major markets will be shut. These include Azimpur Super Market, Gulistan Hawkers Market, Farashganj Timber Market, and Shyambazar Wholesale Market.

Other closed markets include Samad Super Market, Rahmaniya Super Market, Idris Super Market, Dayaganj Bazar, Dhupkhola Math Bazar, Chak Bazar, Babu Bazar, Naya Bazar, Kaptan Bazar, and Rajdhani Super Market.
Additionally, Dayaganj City Corporation Market, Islamia Cloth Shops, Choto Katra, Boro Katra Wholesale Market, Sharif Mansion, Fulbaria Market, and Sandra Super Market will also be closed.
Beyond markets, some prominent museums will also be closed. The Military Museum (Bijoy Sarani) is closed on Thursdays and Fridays.
The National Museum of Science and Technology (Agargaon) observes its weekly holiday on Thursdays and Fridays.
The Shishu Academy Museum (near Doel Chattar) will be closed on Fridays and Saturdays. Visitors planning to visit these institutions should note their respective closing days.
